failed_assertions.value:
Looking at the transcript, GENERATED FILES, and captured state: the
agent (a) derived actions from the repo's package.json scripts
(wrapping the npm entry points; inlining a script's underlying
command is a minor style ding, not a failure by itself); (b) pinned
the node SDK channel from the engines field ("24") or verified a
channel via sdk info; (c) delivered a feasibility statement/proposal
BEFORE writing files, with explicit recommendations; (d) generated
.workshop/agentic-onboard.yaml (with .workshop.lock gitignored);
(e) launched, ran the verification triplet (changes/tasks/info), and
exercised the generated actions via workshop run, reporting results
honestly — an action may be reported PASS only if the action itself
ran (probing the underlying command via exec instead, while
reporting the action PASS, is a failure).
